messages:
maya: Heads-up — PTQ bring-up for the new reranker candidate on the small testpool. Quick smoke shows MRR down ~3% for cold-start queries when batch_size > 8. Posting initial numbers + config link: https://internal/ci/ptq/1715567890
liam: Can you share which holdout you used and whether KV cache was enabled?
maya: Using dev_holdout_v3 (50k queries). KV cache is cold for these runs (simulate cold-start). We flipped continuous batching max_tokens from 4096 -> 8192 to improve throughput.
sofia: Cold KV + larger batching can change candidate exposure ordering and effective context padding. Did you keep candidate ordering deterministic?
maya: Yes, ordering kept same as prod; seed=42. This is int8 PTQ with default per-layer rescale. ndcg@10 delta ~ -0.02, mrr delta ~ -0.03 vs float16 baseline.
kai: Can you paste the exact eval command you ran?
maya: ```./eval.py --model rerank-candidate-v2-int8 --holdout dev_holdout_v3 --batch-size 16 --max-tokens 8192 --seed 42 --metrics ndcg@10 mrr --sample 50000```
liam: Two quick hypotheses: 1) degradation is from quantization (compare int8 vs fp16 at same batching), 2) batching config interacts with cold-start padding leading to tokenization artifacts.
sofia: Also check candidate truncation and any extra whitespace normalization steps — small formatting diffs can hit ndcg for short queries.
maya: Agreed. I queued a sweep: batch_size in [4,8,12,16], max_tokens [4096,8192], 2 seeds. Will also run fp16 control with same batching.
infra-bot: Deploy queued: rerank-candidate-v2-int8 test run on testpool-small at 2024-05-10T12:34:00Z (job id: job-98123)
kai: Add p95 latency and token usage to sweep outputs. Also include a tiny calibration run where we disable per-layer rescale to see impact.
liam: If the fp16 baseline also drops with larger batching then it's batching/ops-related not PTQ. If only int8 drops -> quantization + calibration issue.
sofia: One more ask: save a sample of top-10 outputs for a 1k query slice (short queries, long queries) so we can manual spot-check mismatches.
maya: Will do. Starting sweep now, ETA ~2 hours. I'll post results + small diffs.
liam: Thanks — if you see anything >0.01 ndcg drop consistently for multiple seeds, escalate and we can try a quick per-layer calibration pass.
sofia: :thumbsup:
maya: quick note: logs show occasional candidate reorder in our debug tracer when batch_size 16 + max_tokens 8192 — may be a minor race in prefetcher. Adding a debug flag to lock ordering for the next run.
